en_description.text_excerpt: This is the unique reference output: whole net uncoated artificial graphite powder newly passing its first supply-quality release after coke graphitization and cooling and separation and actual size finishing and clean-up. Keep actual graphitic and minor non-graphitic phases and ash and moisture inside whole delivered powder mass; the graphite assay is only a subledger. Native Product family: processed graphite powder; CAS 7782-42-5; no fixed natural origin or grade or purity or supply geography is declared. Its mineral classification is an isolated taxonomy limitation and does not prove natural origin. Here primary evidence and actual coke-to-graphite history restrict use to whole artificial uncoated powder after size preparation. Exclude natural mined graphite and carbon black and colloidal liquids and coated spherical anode material and shaped electrodes. No synthetic origin is inferred from CAS alone.

Retain all 20 kg at closing; no additions/removals, shipment or waste. Old P=I=ER=0 gives left side 0, right side 20 kg.
